mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals an inflationary environment with easing monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary environment with easing monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
